commit_message: Fix VFX stop and playback state
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 first-release VFX scope
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0125 first-release completion on the existing Draft PR. This correction makes VFX stop distinct from pause, resets deterministic state on stop, and exposes stopped/playing/paused state through the copied Project Rust VFX view.

## Safety

- keeps gameplay control on the deferred GameCommand boundary
- no persisted VFX schema or Stable ID changes
- no direct project ECS access
- no out-of-scope GPU simulation, collision events, sub-emitters, ribbon renderer, soft particles, or vector fields
